rows.description: brainstorming + writing-plans + executing-plans + subagent-driven-development + dispatching-parallel-agents 五件套：苏格拉底式精炼意图 → 拆 2-5 分钟微任务（每任务给精确文件路径+完整代码+验证）→ 批次执行 + 人工 checkpoint → 每任务派 fresh subagent + 双阶段 review（spec 合规 → 代码质量）→ 并行 subagent 编排
rows.description_en: brainstorming + writing-plans + executing-plans + subagent-driven-development + dispatching-parallel-agents five-piece set: Socratically refine intent → break into 2-5 min micro-tasks (each task given exact file path + full code + verification) → batch execution + human checkpoint → dispatch fresh subagent per task + two-phase review (spec compliance → code quality) → parallel subagent orchestration

rows.group: 浏览器自动化（含 LinkedIn / X 社交平台）
rows.description: browser-automation（教授通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 进行浏览器自动化的技能，包括坐标计算、shadow-DOM 处理和真实站点验证。）；browser-edge-cases（提供调试浏览器自动化在复杂网站（如LinkedIn、Twitter）失败的标准操作程序，帮助代理解决边缘情况。）；linkedin-automation（在使用浏览器工具自动化LinkedIn前必须阅读，涵盖处理shadow DOM、CSP等挑战的验证流程，用于消息、连接请求、帖子和搜索等操作，需配合browser-automation使用。）；x-automation（自动化 X/Twitter 操作：发帖、回复、删除、搜索互动，含 Draft.js 编辑器已验证流程）
rows.description_en: browser-automation: Teaches browser automation skills via Chrome DevTools Protocol, covering coordinate calculation, shadow-DOM handling, and verification on real production sites.; browser-edge-cases: SOP for debugging browser automation failures on complex websites like LinkedIn, Twitter/X, SPAs, or sites with Shadow DOM.; linkedin-automation: Required reading before automating LinkedIn with browser_* tools, covering verified flows for handling shadow DOM, CSP, and other challenges for messaging, connection requests, feed posts, and search automation, requiring browser-automation.; x-automation: Automate X/Twitter operations: posting, replying, deleting, search-and-engage, with verified Draft.js compose flows
rows.py: liu lan qi zi dong hua （ han  LinkedIn / X  she jiao ping tai ） browser-automation browser-edge-cases linkedin-automation x-automation

rows.description: terminal-tools-foundations（教导 agent 终端工具的前后台任务管理、输出处理和工具偏好，避免常见错误。）；terminal-tools-fs-search（指导使用 terminal_rg 和 terminal_find 进行项目外部文件系统搜索，包括内容搜索和谓词查询。）；terminal-tools-job-control（教agent管理后台作业，实现启动、轮询、等待及信号处理，适用于构建、部署等长时任务。）；terminal-tools-pty-sessions（教agent使用持久PTY会话，支持跨调用状态保持、驱动REPL和交互式提示。）；terminal-tools-troubleshooting（诊断终端工具调用异常：stdout 为空、exit_code 为 null、session 忙等场景的排查方案）
